'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Ethiopian military]] says that they have recaptured the strategic [[Amhara Region|Amharan]] towns of [[Dessie]] and [[Kombolcha]] from [[United Front of Ethiopian Federalist and Confederalist Forces|rebel forces]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/6/ethiopia-recapture-dessie-kombolcha-tigrayan-rebels (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] reports its first cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in two people who had not travelled abroad. [https://rs.n1info.com/english/news/croatia-confirms-first-two-cases-of-infection-with-omicron-variant/ (N1)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] begins to implement the [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|Super Green Pass]], which allows a person to enter theatres, cinemas, music venues, sports events, restaurants and bars if they are [[COVID-19 vaccination in Italy|vaccinated]] or have recovered from COVID-19 within the past six months. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59548210 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports its first 10 cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a group of citizens who travelled from southern Africa. [https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-omicron-covid-cases/31595932.html (RFE/RL)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
****It is announced that over 50% of India's eligible adult population is now fully vaccinated. [[India]] is targeting 100% [[COVID-19]] adult vaccination by December 31. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/coronavirus/covid-19-indias-50-adult-fully-vaccinated (''Khaleej Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****[[Nepal]] reports its first two cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a 71-year-old Nepali national and a 66-year-old foreigner. [https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal/nepal-reports-first-two-cases-of-omicrant-variant (''The Himalayan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a 38-year-old U.S. citizen who had travelled from [[Spain]] nearly a week ago. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/12/06/world/asia/thailand-omicron-covid.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
*****Outgoing [[New York City Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] announces a [[COVID-19 vaccination mandates in the United States|COVID-19 vaccine mandate]] for all private-sector employees, which will take effect on December 27. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/12/06/nyregion/nyc-vaccine-mandate-deblasio.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut]]
****[[Connecticut]] reports its first case of the SARS-COV-2 Omicron variant. [https://www.fox61.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/connecticut-first-omicron-variant-covid-case/520-87b3d848-047a-43d0-bb2e-141c5b11f2de (WTIC-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] approves the usage of the single-dose [[Sputnik Light]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] as a standalone [[vaccine]] and as a [[booster dose]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/russia-says-argentina-approves-sputnik-light-standalone-booster-vaccine-2021-12-06/ (Reuters)]
***Argentina reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a 38-year-old fully vaccinated person who traveled from [[South Africa]] on November 30. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/argentina-reports-its-1st-case-of-omicron-variant/2439560 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis]], [[Foreign relations of Belarus]]
**[[Belarus]] bans [[airline]]s and imports of certain goods from the [[European Union]] and [[United Kingdom]] in retaliation for [[Economic sanctions|sanctions]] imposed on the country by [[Western world|Western]] nations. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/belarus-bans-western-imports-airlines-eu-uk-81584021 (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*In [[Madagascar]], twenty people, including two [[France|French]] nationals, are charged with crimes including criminal conspiracy, criminal association, rebellion against the president and possession of illegal weapons, for allegedly plotting to kill [[President of Madagascar|president]] [[Andry Rajoelina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/twenty-charged-with-plotting-kill-madagascar-president-trial-begins-2021-12-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Solomon Islands unrest]]
**[[Prime Minister of Solomon Islands|Prime Minister]] [[Manasseh Sogavare]] survives a [[no-confidence vote]] in the [[National Parliament of Solomon Islands|National Parliament]] after his management of the [[riot]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/solomon-islands-prime-minister-faces-no-confidence-vote-after-riots-2021-12-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Karl Nehammer]] is sworn in as the new [[Chancellor of Austria]] after the [[resignation]] of [[Alexander Schallenberg]] on December 2. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/nehammer-sworn-austrias-chancellor-months-81581062 (ABC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Winter Olympics]]
**The [[United States]] announces a formal diplomatic [[boycott]] of the upcoming Winter Olympic Games in [[Beijing]], [[China]]. The [[White House]] says that no official delegation will be sent to the Games due to concerns regarding China's human rights record. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-59556613 (BBC Sport)]
